meta_title: BOTIA — Delete your account and data
meta_description: How to request deletion of your BOTIA account and associated data.
h1: Delete your BOTIA account and data
subtitle: BOTIA is developed by ServiceHub, Tilburg, the Netherlands.
intro: This page explains how to request the deletion of your BOTIA account and the data associated with it, what is deleted, and what is kept.
step2: Use "Delete my BOTIA account" as the subject line.
step3: Send it from the same Google account you use to sign in to BOTIA. This is how we identify your record.
step4: We confirm the request by email and complete the deletion within 30 days.
cancellation_note: You do not need to give a reason. You can also request deletion at any time without cancelling a subscription first, although cancelling the subscription is managed separately through Google Play.
stores_intro: BOTIA is designed to hold as little as possible. It does not store your name, your email address, your photos or your scan history.
row_google_hash: Hashed Google identifier (one-way, cannot be reversed to an email)
kept_intro: Once your account is deleted, the record described above is removed and cannot be recovered.
kept_paragraph: Two things are not deleted, and neither identifies you:
kept_item1: Anonymous scan records. BOTIA keeps the ingredient text read from labels, without any user identifier attached, to improve detection accuracy. These records cannot be linked back to you.
kept_item2: Payment records held by Google. Purchases are processed by Google Play, not by BOTIA. Google keeps its own transaction records under its own retention rules. BOTIA cannot delete them.
